# verygood chocolate Sydney

> Chocolate cakes made with chocolatier-grade couverture chocolate for birthdays, parties and gifting. Cake pick-up · Fri 18:00–20:00 · Sat–Sun 08:00–20:00

Official AU website: https://au.verygood-chocolate.com
Primary service area: Melrose Park, Sydney
Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/verygood_syd/

## Ordering
- Choose a cake and options.
- Send a request so availability can be checked.
- Receive payment details after availability is confirmed.
- Collect in Melrose Park after final confirmation · Fri 18:00–20:00 · Sat–Sun 08:00–20:00.

## Cakes
- Pave Chocolate Cake: A rich four-layer chocolate cake built for a dense, chocolate-forward bite. Instead of a light sponge-and-cream style, each layer is filled with smooth pave chocolate ganache, creating a substantial cake with deep chocolate flavour from the first slice to the last. From AUD 79.00. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size · dark chocolate only https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/pave-chocolate-cake
- Vanilla Fresh Cream Cake: Our Signature Gâteau au Chocolat layers are filled with vanilla fresh cream made with 100% fresh milk and real vanilla bean. The natural vanilla bean specks are visible throughout the cream. From AUD 69.00. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size · Vanilla fresh cream with real vanilla bean https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/vanilla-fresh-cream-cake
- Buttercream Cake: Our Signature Gâteau au Chocolat layers are filled and finished with chocolate buttercream made with organic cocoa, fresh milk and chocolatier-grade couverture chocolate. The deep, intense chocolate taste comes from real cocoa and couverture—not added chocolate flavouring. From AUD 74.00. 6 inch serves 8, 7.5 inch serves 14, and 9 inch serves 22. Choose a size and cake colour · Chocolate Buttercream included https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/buttercream-cake
- Chocolate Cupcakes: Chocolate cupcakes for sharing, parties and easy gifting. Choose a half dozen or dozen, then select one finish for the whole box. From AUD 31.00. Choose a half dozen or dozen, then select Basic, Vanilla Fresh Cream, or Chocolate Buttercream. Choose a pack size and one finish for the whole box https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/chocolate-cupcakes
- Signature Gâteau au Chocolat: A rich rectangular gâteau au chocolat finished with dark chocolate. Simple, compact and easy to share or gift. AUD 45.00. Choose Basic finish, Extra chocolate +AUD 7.00, or Vanilla cream +AUD 10.00. Choose one finish option https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/signature-gateau-au-chocolat
- Lemon Cake: Lemon-shaped cakes made with freshly squeezed lemon juice, filled with fresh lemon cream and finished with a floral decoration. From AUD 36.00. Boxes of 6, 8, 12 or 16. Choose a pack size and finishing mix. The 12-piece box is Most Popular. https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/lemon-cake
- Brownie Cheesecake: A 6 inch Brownie Cheesecake serving 8, with three finishing options. From AUD 55.00. Basic AUD 55.00, pave chocolate on top AUD 65.00, or full pave chocolate finish with one Eiffel Tower chocolate AUD 70.00. 6 inch serves 8 · three finishing options https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/cakes/brownie-cheesecake

## Kids cake classes
- Two limited Saturday cake class dates in Melrose Park, Sydney: 3 and 10 October 2026, with sessions at 10:00, 13:00 and 16:00. Basic welcomes children from Kindy to Year 6; Advanced starts from Year 2.
- Base course/package prices: AUD 99.00–254.60.
- A Basic + Advanced package covers two separate Spring Vacation sessions and receives 5% off the base class fees.
- A 30-minute extension is AUD 20.00 per participant, per class and is not discounted.
- https://au.verygood-chocolate.com/classes
